title: Source
description: Where a fact came from. Today this is a free-form string with a default ('manual') in transactions.Transaction.Source, documented as provenance that 'survives every operation'; the sidecar has one Source struct per feed (backend/data/internal/research/news/modes.go) and price_history carries a `source` column. This contract keeps the string, names the closed set of kinds, and requires the id form so a row can be traced without re-parsing a label.

kind.description: What sort of origin this is.

name.description: Display label: the outlet's own name ('Cointelegraph'), a venue name, or a chain name - never the request parameter that selected it.

sensitivity.description: Most restrictive sensitivity class of any value this source can yield. A downstream field inherits it (docs/architecture/canonical-model.md section 6.3).
